tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Evaluates exact mathematical expressions using rational CAS or math functions.

expression.description: Mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '14 * 28 + 5' or '(2/3) + (4/7)'

tools.name: python_repl
tools.description: Executes Python code in an isolated sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, and the evaluated result.

code.description: Python code snippet or script to execute

tools.name: system_time
tools.description: Returns the current system date, time, and timestamp in ISO format.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches external web sources or local search index and returns ranked structured results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return

tools.name: file_reader
tools.description: Safely reads text contents of a project file within authorized workspace boundaries.

file_path.description: Relative path to target file within workspace

tools.name: file_writer
tools.description: Safely writes or appends content to a local file within authorized workspace boundaries.

append.description: Whether to append to existing file

tools.name: bash_executor
tools.description: Executes whitelisted non-destructive shell commands in a sandboxed subprocess.
